name: DMS Daily Sales Activity Report API
script:
# DMS Daily Sales Activity Report (read-only) # API Method: dms_daily_sales_activity_report # Source: DMS Follow Up History rows on DMS Project (follow-up date entered by the salesperson). # Nothing is created, changed or sent by this API. user = frappe.session.user roles = frappe.db.get_all("Has Role", filters={"parent": user, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="role") is_admin = (user == "Administrator") or ("System Manager" in roles) if not (is_admin or ("DMS Sales Dashboard Access" in roles) or ("Technical Coordinator" in roles)): frappe.throw("You are not permitted to view the Daily DMS Sales Activity Report.") can_send = is_admin or ("DMS Sales Dashboard Access" in roles) args = frappe.form_dict raw_date = (args.get("date") or "").strip() filter_person = (args.get("sales_person") or "").strip() weekday_names = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"] today_date = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.today()) # Working week: Sunday to Thursday (Python weekday: Friday = 4, Saturday = 5) if raw_date: report_date = frappe.utils.getdate(raw_date) else: report_date = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.add_days(today_date, -1)) for step in range(7): if report_date.weekday() in (4, 5): report_date = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.add_days(report_date, -1)) report_date_str = str(report_date) weekday_name = weekday_names[report_date.weekday()] is_working_day = report_date.weekday() not in (4, 5) date_label = frappe.utils.formatdate(report_date_str, "dd MMMM yyyy") def esc_text(value): text = str(value if value is not None else "") return text.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">").replace('"', """) def emp_name_for(emp, cache): if emp not in cache: erow = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", emp, ["employee_name", "status"], as_dict=True) or {} cache[emp] = " ".join((erow.get("employee_name") or emp).split()) cache[emp + "|status"] = erow.get("status") or "" return cache[emp] emp_names = {} people = {} project_info = {} def new_person(emp, cache): pname = emp_name_for(emp, cache) pstatus = cache.get(emp + "|status") or "" # Employees whose status is not Active (for example Inactive or Left) are flagged separately. return {"employee": emp, "employee_name": pname, "projects": 0, "activities": 0, "overdue": 0, "late": 0, "inactive": 1 if (pstatus and pstatus != "Active") else 0, "employee_status": pstatus} # Allocated projects: per-salesperson project counts and current overdue follow-ups projects = frappe.db.get_all( "DMS Project", filters={"sales_person": ["is", "set"]}, fields=["name", "project_code", "project_name", "sales_person", "follow_up_status", "next_follow_up_date"], limit_page_length=0 ) overdue_total = 0 for pr in projects: project_info[pr.get("name")] = pr emp = pr.get("sales_person") if filter_person and emp != filter_person: continue if emp not in people: people[emp] = new_person(emp, emp_names) people[emp]["projects"] = people[emp]["projects"] + 1 nfd = pr.get("next_follow_up_date") if nfd and frappe.utils.getdate(nfd) < today_date and pr.get("follow_up_status") not in ("Won", "Lost"): people[emp]["overdue"] = people[emp]["overdue"] + 1 overdue_total = overdue_total + 1 # Activities recorded for the selected date history = frappe.db.get_all( "DMS Follow Up History", filters={"parenttype": "DMS Project", "follow_up_date": report_date_str}, fields=["name", "parent", "follow_up_status", "next_follow_up_date", "remarks", "followed_up_by", "sales_person", "created_on"], limit_page_length=0 ) status_counts = {"Contacted": 0, "Meeting Scheduled": 0, "Quotation Submitted": 0, "Negotiation": 0, "Won": 0, "Lost": 0} activities = [] projects_with_activity = {} late_total = 0 for h in history: parent_id = h.get("parent") info = project_info.get(parent_id) if not info: info = frappe.db.get_value("DMS Project", parent_id, ["name", "project_code", "project_name", "sales_person"], as_dict=True) or {} emp = h.get("sales_person") or info.get("sales_person") if filter_person and emp != filter_person: continue if emp and emp not in people: people[emp] = new_person(emp, emp_names) late = False created = h.get("created_on") if created and frappe.utils.getdate(created) > report_date: late = True late_total = late_total + 1 if emp: people[emp]["activities"] = people[emp]["activities"] + 1 if late: people[emp]["late"] = people[emp]["late"] + 1 status_value = h.get("follow_up_status") or "" if status_value in status_counts: status_counts[status_value] = status_counts[status_value] + 1 projects_with_activity[parent_id] = 1 nfd_value = h.get("next_follow_up_date") activities.append({ "project": parent_id, "project_code": info.get("project_code") or parent_id, "project_name": info.get("project_name") or "", "employee": emp or "", "employee_name": emp_name_for(emp, emp_names) if emp else "", "status": status_value, "remarks": h.get("remarks") or "", "next_follow_up_date": str(nfd_value) if nfd_value else "", "late": late, "created_on": str(created)[:16] if created else "" }) people_rows = [] no_activity = [] active_count = 0 inactive_total = 0 for emp in people: people_rows.append(people[emp]) if people[emp]["inactive"]: inactive_total = inactive_total + 1 continue if people[emp]["activities"] > 0: active_count = active_count + 1 elif is_working_day: no_activity.append({"employee": emp, "employee_name": people[emp]["employee_name"], "projects": people[emp]["projects"]}) people_rows.sort(key=lambda p: (-p["activities"], -p["overdue"], p["employee_name"])) no_activity.sort(key=lambda p: p["employee_name"]) activities.sort(key=lambda a: (a["employee_name"], a["project_code"])) summary = { "activities": len(activities), "active_salespeople": active_count, "total_salespeople": len(people_rows) - inactive_total, "inactive_salespeople": inactive_total, "projects_with_activity": len(projects_with_activity), "overdue_followups": overdue_total, "overdue_as_of": str(today_date), "overdue_as_of_label": frappe.utils.formatdate(today_date, "dd MMMM yyyy"), "late_entries": late_total } def build_email(date_text, weekday_text, working, sm, counts, rows, none_list, acts, esc): th = "padding:6px 10px;text-align:left;background:#f1f5f9;border-bottom:1px solid #d1d5db;font-size:12px;" td = "padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef2f7;font-size:12px;vertical-align:top;" tile = "padding:10px 14px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;text-align:center;" h = '
' h = h + '

Daily DMS Sales Activity Report

' day_note = "" if not working: day_note = " - non-working day" h = h + '
' + esc(date_text) + " (" + esc(weekday_text) + ")" + day_note + "
" h = h + '' tiles = [ ["Activities", sm["activities"]], ["Active Salespeople", str(sm["active_salespeople"]) + " / " + str(sm["total_salespeople"])], ["Projects with Activity", sm["projects_with_activity"]], ["Overdue Follow-ups (as of " + str(sm["overdue_as_of_label"]) + ")", sm["overdue_followups"]] ] for item in tiles: h = h + '" h = h + "
' + esc(item[1]) + '
' + esc(item[0]) + "
" h = h + '
Recorded statuses: Contacted ' + str(counts["Contacted"]) + ", Meeting Scheduled " + str(counts["Meeting Scheduled"]) + ", Quotation Submitted " + str(counts["Quotation Submitted"]) + ", Negotiation " + str(counts["Negotiation"]) + ", Won " + str(counts["Won"]) + ", Lost " + str(counts["Lost"]) + ".
" h = h + '

Salesperson Activity Summary

' h = h + '' shown = 0 for p in rows: if p["activities"] > 0 or p["overdue"] > 0: shown = shown + 1 act_text = str(p["activities"]) if p["activities"] == 0 and working: act_text = "No activity recorded" h = h + '" if shown == 0: h = h + '' h = h + "
SalespersonProjectsActivitiesOverdue
' + esc(p["employee_name"]) + '' + str(p["projects"]) + '' + esc(act_text) + '' + str(p["overdue"]) + "
No activity or overdue follow-ups to report.
" if len(none_list) > 0: names = [] for n in none_list: names.append(esc(n["employee_name"])) h = h + '
No activity recorded (' + str(len(none_list)) + "): " + ", ".join(names) + "
" h = h + '

Project-wise Activities

' h = h + '' if len(acts) == 0: h = h + '' for a in acts: late_text = "" if a["late"]: late_text = ' (late entry)' h = h + '" h = h + "
ProjectSalespersonActivityRemarksNext follow-up
No project activity was recorded for this date.
' + esc(a["project_code"]) + "
" + esc(a["project_name"]) + '		' + esc(a["employee_name"]) + '' + esc(a["status"]) + late_text + '' + esc(a["remarks"]) + '' + esc(a["next_follow_up_date"] or "-") + "
" h = h + '
Source: DMS follow-up records dated ' + esc(date_text) + ". Statuses such as Won are salesperson-recorded pipeline statuses; they do not confirm an ERPNext Sales Order. This report covers DMS activity only, not other daily sales responsibilities.
" h = h + "
" return h email_html = build_email(date_label, weekday_name, is_working_day, summary, status_counts, people_rows, no_activity, activities, esc_text) frappe.response["message"] = { "status": "success", "date": report_date_str, "date_label": date_label, "weekday": weekday_name, "is_working_day": is_working_day, "can_send": can_send, "filter_person": filter_person, "summary": summary, "status_counts": status_counts, "salespeople": people_rows, "activities": activities, "no_activity": no_activity, "email_subject": "Daily DMS Sales Activity Report - " + date_label, "email_html": email_html }
